item.title: Real life
item.description:
I decide to create this blog to share real life experices of a software engineer in a world where it seems there is no more reality, where everyone seems perfect, super efficient with no flaws building rocket-science projects.

However, the truth is a way from that and software engineering is more like an empty canvas where engineers work as artists, painting the next portrait filed with uncertaints but doing their best to make the least wrong decisions…

item.title: About me
item.description:
Hey there, Cris here!

I am a software engineer that loves learning and sharing knowladge and expiriences. My entire carrer has been around Python 🐍 and its frameworks as well as the countless additional tools a software engineer must handle.

I have been working in different business in the IT industry, for example Agro, Educational and Oil and Gas.

Currently I have been digging deeper into system design concepts and obvously AI.
